name: pay-for-performance-monorepo
description: AI-powered SLA-based payment settlement platform — Monorepo Architecture

scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/payments run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/payments test && npm --prefix apps/api test
